description: This file defines the class SugarFieldId, which extends SugarFieldBase and provides an importSanitize method for handling ID fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SugarFieldId
classes.description: A class representing a specialized field type for handling IDs in the CRM framework, extending functionality from SugarFieldBase.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the input value for import, returning false if the value exceeds 36 characters, otherwise returning the value.
